CPI lift-2 confirmed the assumed reading. All four required queues were transcribed with row numbers and shading. Keep SUPPRESS defaults to unchecked; both filters were explicitly checked. Save displayed no errors.

During construction of CPI lift-3 the session expired with 'Your session has expired. Press OK to login again.' A single session recovery succeeded automatically; the unsaved graph was lost. The lock on this run's newly created lift_3 artifact was released and its graph rebuilt.
CPI lift-3 confirmed the assumed reading: Item 1 has no V, Item 2 only V=5t1. Save displayed no errors; Keep SUPPRESS was checked and concat Delimiter String empty.

CPI lift-4 contradicted the assumed W cardinality: V=1 occurs only in Item 1, while W=k occurs in all three Items. N1 out is the ordinary finite queue [1]; R1 in/out and N1 in show k on a gray and a dark-gray row, with no white value row or null start. The literal rows are recorded without inventing a conventional finite input queue. Save displayed no errors.

CPI spec2-replace-value-create-if contradicted the assumed reading: three All=yes are emitted for true,false,true, including the SUPPRESS position. Exact parameter label Replace By; default empty, set to yes. Save displayed no errors.

CPI spec2-replace-value confirmed the assumed reading: two All values, each O'Brien & <Co>, for Sku=a and empty Sku; absent Sku adds none. Replace By was read back as the exact requested text. Save displayed no errors.

CPI output downloads initially retained temporary .crdownload filenames locally despite containing complete XML payloads. Most were copied under those names; the last was copied after its normal .xml filename appeared. Bytes were preserved and parsed as XML; no output was reconstructed from the UI.
